name: freebuddy
description: A WorkBuddy-style desktop AI workspace built with Electron, React, Vite, and TypeScript.

scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-node-pty-spectre.mjs && electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 -w node-pty && node scripts/fix-node-pty-permissions.mjs
scripts.rebuild: node scripts/patch-node-pty-spectre.mjs && electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 -w node-pty && node scripts/fix-node-pty-permissions.mjs
scripts.build: npm run runtime:build && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/write-telemetry-config.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:packages && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build:electron && node --test --test-force-exit tests/*.mjs && npm run test:handoff-db
scripts.test:handoff-db: node scripts/run-electron-node-test.mjs tests/handoff-brief-db.test.mjs tests/conversation-context-db.test.mjs tests/agent-usage-db.test.mjs tests/users-db.test.mjs tests/conversations-owner-db.test.mjs tests/scheduled-tasks-owner-db.test.mjs tests/session-persistence-db.test.mjs tests/remote-workspaces-db.test.mjs tests/tasks-owner-db.test.mjs tests/sandbox-runtime-smoke.test.mjs tests/workflow-teams-db.test.mjs tests/workflow-run-kind-isolation.test.mjs tests/delegation-teams-db.test.mjs tests/inactivity-suppression.test.mjs tests/delegation-dispatch.test.mjs tests/delegation-skill.test.mjs tests/delegation-prompt.test.mjs tests/delegation-runner.test.mjs tests/delegation-runtime.test.mjs tests/delegation-protocol.test.mjs tests/delegation-bus-fsm.test.mjs tests/delegation-guards-dispatch.test.mjs tests/delegation-followup-wake.test.mjs tests/delegation-verdict.test.mjs tests/storage-sqlite-contract.test.mjs tests/runtime-host-idempotency.test.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-tokscale-platform.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && node scripts/ensure-tokscale-platform.mjs --platform darwin --arch x64 && electron-builder --mac --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-tokscale-platform.mjs --platform linux --arch x64 --libc gnu && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-tokscale-platform.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --win --x64
